contacts_gstin_uq.name: contacts_gstin_uq
contacts_gstin_uq.where: "contacts"."gstin" is not null and "contacts"."deleted_at" is null

invoices_serial_rule.name: invoices_serial_rule
invoices_serial_rule.value:
("invoices"."doc_type"='purchase' and "invoices"."serial" is null and "invoices"."supplier_invoice_no" is not null)
        or("invoices"."doc_type"<>'purchase' and serial is not null and invoice_no is not null)

invoices_need_note_ref.name: invoices_need_note_ref
invoices_need_note_ref.value: doc_type not in ('credit_note','debit_note') OR ref_invoice_id is not null

invoices_amount_non_negative.name: invoices_amount_non_negative
invoices_amount_non_negative.value: gross >=0 and discount_total>=0 and taxable>=0 and grand_total>=0

ledger_entries_has_invoice.name: ledger_entries_has_invoice
ledger_entries_has_invoice.value: entry_type in('opening','payment_received','payment_paid') or invoice_id is not null

ledger_entries_payment_mode.name: ledger_entries_payment_mode
ledger_entries_payment_mode.value: entry_type not in ('payment_received','payment_paid') or mode is not null
